CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:30 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

November 28, 2023

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B. ROLL CALL:

Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to
be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration.

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: November 14, 2023
Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted the
minutes of the November 14, 2023, regular meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:
  • Board Member Ng moved to pull the consent item to discussion.

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: November 14, 2023
  • Board Member Ng recalls the motion for item #9 on the November 14, 2023 DRB
  meeting to include in the conditions, the condition for the arched front door to match
  with the arched front porch entrance. Ng asked Staff if this was included in the
  motion. The board asked that Staff review the recording to ensure that this
  condition was or was not included in the motion. If the condition was missed and
  not included in the motion, Ng is okay with it. Staff later reviewed the November
  14th recording and determined that the motion for item #9 did not include the
  condition as mentioned by Ng.

  1
 MOTION:
  • Vice Chairman Hernandez moved to approve the project with the following
  conditions: 1) Staff shall review the November 14, 2023 DRB meeting recording to
  verify item #9 motion is correct, or to correct as needed.
  • The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Abstained:  Ng

ITEM 2:  500 South Date Avenue

  •  This is an application for one (1) new 2” foam lettering sign on a wall 1-story
  commercial building on a single parcel for one (1) tenant (for business known as
  “Caltop”).
  •  Applicant: Alexis Estrada
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with conditions of approval.
  •  Discussion: Applicant is not present. Vice Chair Hernandez asked for clarification
  on Staff recommendation #1. Staff responded that the Planning Division is okay
  with the overall dimensions and square footage as shown in the signage detail
  drawing; however, the square footage calculation number is incorrect and needs
  to be revised. Board Member Ng asked if the sign will be illuminated. Staff
  responded that there is no proposed lighting on the sign since this is an industrial
  use which will not be open to the public. Vice Chairman Hernandez is okay with no
  illumination.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) Revise the plans to provide the correct square footage of the sign;
  and 2) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect
  to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 3:  605 Orange Grove Avenue

  •  This is an application for four (4) window replacements on an existing 2-story
  house and new roofing on an existing 2-car garage.
  •  Applicant: Kelvin Lee
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with conditions of approval.
  •  Discussion: Applicant is present. Board Member Ng agreed with Staff
  recommendation on providing mullions on windows to match the existing, as well
  as match color and style of trim. Board Member Ng also noted that the application

  2
   does not provide proposed garage roof color or reference to match existing. Board
  Member Daninger asked why the Board is reviewing the garage roof replacement.
  Vice Chair Hernandez responded the new roof is visible from the public street.
  Chairman Udani asked if the new roof is changing in color. The applicant
  responded that the new roofing is changing in color to match the new roofing on
  the existing house which has been approved by the Building Division. The
  applicant explains that the windows will match mullions to existing and it is a
  graphical error. Chairman Udani asked the applicant if they plan to replace or
  refurbish the existing window trims. The applicant responded, yes, with the
  exception of windows which are being enlarged. Chariman Udani stated that the
  trim color would match existing. Vice Chairman Hernandez noted that the window
  schedule is showing four (4) windows that are existing and proposed to be vinyl.
  The applicant responded stating the schedule is wrong, and all windows are
  existing wood frame and proposed to be vinyl. Vice Chairman Hernandez and
  Chairman Udani noted that the scope of work is not specifying the number of
  windows being replaced.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chairman Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) Revise the window schedule to accurately identify the number of
  existing windows to be replaced with new, including window material and type; 2)
  The applicant shall maintain the existing window trim throughout the project in
  terms of color, material, and style; and 3) The applicant shall resubmit a revised
  set of drawings for the City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 4:  211 South Cordova Street

  •  This is an application for a 15 square foot addition to the rear, 20 window
  replacements, and one (1) exterior door replacement on an existing 2-story house.
  •  Applicant: Nathan Gallardo
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with conditions of approval.
  •  Discussion: Applicant is present. Board Member Ng has recused herself from the
  meeting prior to the start of discussion on this item. Public comment was given by
  Bert Ng, neighboring resident, providing background history of the house such as
  when the house was built and the original designer. Bert Ng noted that the
  overarching theme of the house needs to match the Craftsman style which is seen
  in the neighborhood. Bert Ng cited previous remarks made by the Board Members
  during a previous DRB meeting regarding the house. Bert Ng noted the proposed
  windows are a good step forward and are in the Craftsman style, but should be
  authentic to the neighborhood, and suggested the window should be larger in size
  and more proportional. Bert Ng noted there should be a second window on the 2nd
  floor of the house where the stair is located. Secretary Kuchenski asked if the
  proposed window changes are existing openings. Staff responded, yes, and there

  3
   are a few windows being relocated and enlarged. Chairman Udani asked the
  applicant which windows are changing in size. The applicant responded the 2nd floor
  window facing Cordova is getting larger, one (1) window at the 1st floor is staying the
  same size, one (1) window at the 1st floor is getting smaller, and one (1) window is
  being replaced with two (2) new windows with a smaller height. Vice Chairman
  Hernandez noted that the window schedule is too general and does not list individual
  existing and proposed windows. Vice Chairman Hernandez asked if the infill shade
  represents the window getting smaller in size. The applicant responded, no, the
  window could be either reducing in size or moving/relocated, which is why the infill
  occurs. Bert Ng noted that the proposed laundry room window is getting smaller. The
  applicant responded stating the window is responding to the interior programming.
  Secretary Kuchenski asked if the window trim and sash is proposed to appear as
  shown in the window specification / product detail. The applicant responded, yes, all
  window replacements will have a similar trim and sash as shown in the specification.
  Chairman Udani stated the elevation graphics should closely match to what is being
  proposed in terms of window style, trim, and sash. Vice Chairman Hernandez asked
  if the applicant is opposed to adding a window on the 2nd floor where the interior stair
  is located. The applicant is okay with a new window so long as the structural
  framework is accepting of the change. Bert Ng noted that the original openings were
  larger in size and the original windows were replaced at some point in time. Board
  Member Tsai asked that the window on the West Elevation be more centered to the
  proposed gable roof. Board Member Tsai also noted that overall the windows should
  be proportional in size and location. Bert Ng agreed with Board Member Tsai and
  noted the windows at the front facing Cordova Street should be larger and therefore,
  more proportional. Vice Chairman Hernandez noted the drafting error where
  demolition and proposed lightwork overlaps. Chairman Udani asked if the door
  design is to be as shown in elevation. The applicant responded, yes, the graphics
  shown in elevation is what is being proposed. Secretary Kuchenski noted this should
  be more Craftsman style and window dividers should be further specified.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chairman Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant shall work with City Staff to have the window schedule
  revised to include window count, type, size, material, grid system, and trim; 2)
  Revise Bedroom #3 2nd floor window facing South Cordova Street to be well-
  balanced with the new proposed window at the staircase; 3) Revise elevation
  graphics to closely represent the proposed window style as shown in the window
  specifications; 4) The applicant shall submit additional window grid / mullion
  information for Staff’s review; 5) Revise the two (2) window sizes at the 1st floor
  kitchen and laundry areas to be proportional in size and scale along the North
  façade; 6) Relocate the 2nd floor window to be at centerline with the proposed gable
  roof facing the south façade; and 7) Provide specification or product information
  on the door selection, such as type, color and material, and work with Staff on
  determining a door style that aligns with the Craftsman style.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Abstained:  Ng

  4
 ITEM 5:  2000 West Mission Road

This is an application for four (4) new wall mounted signs on a new proposed 3-story
storage building on a single parcel for one (1) tenant.
  • Applicant: Ann MacDonald
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.
  • Discussion: Contractor is present. Vice Chairman Hernandez asked for
  clarification on Staff recommendation #1 on required signage square footage
  calculation. Staff responded that the required square footage is based on linear
  feet provided along the proposed façade. Chairman Udani noted the signage is not
  limited by a specific height or width but rather square footage. Vice Chairman
  Hernandez asked what percentage or square footage is being requested. Staff
  stated that the applicant is proposing a sign along an approximate 25 linear foot
  width which will require a maximum of 12.5 square feet. Vice Chairman Hernandez
  stated that this is too small. Vice Chairman Hernandez asked the applicant to use
  the total 57 linear feet as shown in the plans to allow for a more proportional sign.
  Staff responded that the applicant can use the setback façade where the staircase
  is to provide additional linear feet, which would result in 30 feet. Chariman Udani,
  Vice Chairman Hernandez and Board Member Ng noted they like the sign the way
  that it is shown the plans.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Hernandez moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 6:  823 South Sierra Vista Avenue

This is an application for a new 1,775 square foot 2-story unit and attached 2-car garage
located in the rear of an existing residential property with an existing 1-story single-family
house at the front with a detached garage.
  • Applicant: Dat Wong
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  • Discussion: Applicant is present. Board Member Daninger asked if the new 2-car
  garage is adding square footage to the existing garage. Staff responded, no, the
  square footage of the garage will remain the same, just designating it as a 2-car
  garage. Vice Chairman Hernandez asked if the proposed door is black. The
  applicant responded, no, it is proposed to be dark brown. Board Member Ng asked
  if the 2nd floor window above the garage could be centered on the façade. The
  applicant noted that the bedroom layout will be awkward if the window location is
  relocated to the center. Board Member Tsai stated that this window could either
  be centered or could become two (2) smaller windows. The applicant agreed to
  center the window for Bedroom #2. Vice Chairman Hernandez asked that Bedroom

  5
   #4 window along the west façade be closely centered to the gable roof. The
  applicant stated the window could not be centered due to the program and the
  exterior façade, and highlights that this window is in the rear. Staff recommended
  that the window move closer to the center of the façade and be more proportional.
  Vice Chairman Hernandez asked the applicant what the color and finish of the
  proposed gable detailing and columns will be. The applicant responded the
  detailing and column will be stucco finish. Staff recommends the detail and column
  be wood material and painted, rather than a stucco finish. Board Member Tsai and
  Board Member Ng agreed that the detailing and columns should be wood that is
  painted. Board Member Daninger noted that the neighboring porch shows wood
  columns and details painted white. Vice Chairman Hernandez stated this should
  be painted to match the fascia color.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chairman Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) Revise Bedroom #2 windows on the 2nd floor to either be a single
  window centered along the East façade, or to propose two (2) smaller windows
  proportional along the East façade; 2) The applicant shall work with Staff on
  relocating Bedroom #4 window along the west elevation to be well-balanced and
  proportioned on the West façade; 3) The applicant shall revise proposed front
  porch columns and gable detail to be a wood material that is painted and work with
  Staff on the color selection; and 4) The applicant shall specify the proposed color
  of garage door and north side door.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on December 12, 2023.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chairman Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 9:30 P.M.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_____________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
